aliases: Observation of J/psi p resonances consistent with pentaquark states in Lambda_b0 -> J/psi K- p decays

claim.quote: Observation of $J/\psi p$ resonances consistent with pentaquark states in ${\Lambda_b^0\to J/\psi K^-p}$ decays

date.quote: Observations of exotic structures in the J/ψp channel, which we refer to as charmonium-pentaquark states, in Λb0→J/ψK-p decays are presented.

key_value_text.quote: One has a mass of 4380 ± 8 ± 29 MeV and a width of 205 ± 18 ± 86 MeV, while the second is narrower, with a mass of 4449.8 ± 1.7 ± 2.5 MeV and a width of 39 ± 5 ± 19 MeV.

name: Observation of J/ψ p resonances consistent with pentaquark states in Λb⁰ → J/ψ K⁻ p decays

significance.quote: The significance of each of these resonances is more than 9 standard deviations.

summary.plain: LHCb found two new particles made of five quarks each (pentaquarks) hiding inside the decay of a heavier particle, confirming a type of matter predicted but never confirmed since the 1960s.
summary.technical: Amplitude analysis of Λb0→J/ψK-p decays reveals two resonant structures in the J/ψp mass spectrum, each with significance exceeding 9 standard deviations, consistent with pentaquark (five-quark, ccuud) states: masses 4380±8±29 MeV (width 205±18±86 MeV) and 4449.8±1.7±2.5 MeV (width 39±5±19 MeV), with preferred opposite-parity JP assignments of 3/2 and 5/2.

title: Observation of J/ψp Resonances Consistent with Pentaquark States in Λb0→J/ψK−p Decays
why_it_matters: Pentaquark states (five-quark combinations) had been searched for since the 1960s quark model without a confirmed observation; LHCb's amplitude analysis provided the first statistically compelling evidence for genuine multi-quark states beyond ordinary mesons and baryons.
